category_fits.label: Business Performance & Growth
category_fits.why_fit: The report is a global benchmark of app performance, repeatedly comparing installs, sessions, retention, acquisition costs, and growth across 2024–2025 to inform growth strategy.
category_fits.why_not_fit: The performance metrics are framed within mobile app verticals rather than broad corporate profitability or margin performance.
evidence_sections: Introduction: Evolution and opportunity in the mobile app industry
supported_topic_rules: Evidence emphasizes app growth and performance benchmarks.
The benchmark is intended to inform growth strategy and campaign optimization.
rule_evidence_sections: Introduction: Evolution and opportunity in the mobile app industry
category_fits.remediation_signal: No remediation guidance is central to the report.

category_fits.label: Measurement & Attribution
category_fits.why_fit: The report discusses cross-channel measurement, multi-platform data, and app performance metrics.
category_fits.why_not_fit: Measurement is a supporting topic; the report primarily benchmarks app outcomes rather than explaining attribution, incrementality, or formal measurement frameworks.
evidence_sections: Introduction: Evolution and opportunity in the mobile app industry
Mobile-first approach evolves into multi-platform strategy
rejected_topic_rules: Metrics and measurement discussion serve a broader app-performance report rather than making measurement the central subject.
rule_evidence_sections: Mobile-first approach evolves into multi-platform strategy
category_fits.remediation_signal: Measurement is discussed as an enabler, not the report's main decision domain.

category_fits.label: AI & Automation
category_fits.why_fit: A section discusses generative AI maturity, AI assistants, predictive segmentation, and AI-supported marketing workflows.
category_fits.why_not_fit: The report is principally a mobile app performance benchmark; AI is one supporting topic among app growth, measurement, acquisition, and retention.
evidence_sections: Introduction: Evolution and opportunity in the mobile app industry
AI transforms from strategic tool to core infrastructure in 2026
rejected_topic_rules: AI is an enabler inside a broader vertical-market report rather than its central topic.
rule_evidence_sections: AI transforms from strategic tool to core infrastructure in 2026
category_fits.remediation_signal: AI is covered as an enabling capability, not as the report's primary subject.

category_fits.label: Omni-Channel Marketing
category_fits.why_fit: The report describes user journeys across mobile web, desktop, apps, and other channels, and recommends integrated measurement and coordinated journeys.
category_fits.why_not_fit: This discussion is concentrated in one section; the report's central content is app performance benchmarking, not coordinated marketing planning and activation across channels.
evidence_sections: Introduction: Evolution and opportunity in the mobile app industry
Mobile-first approach evolves into multi-platform strategy
rejected_topic_rules: Cross-channel discussion is not the central subject of the broader app benchmark.
rule_evidence_sections: Mobile-first approach evolves into multi-platform strategy
category_fits.remediation_signal: Cross-platform strategy is discussed, but does not define the report's main purpose.

category_fits.label: Advertising Strategy & Media
category_fits.why_fit: The introduction discusses campaign optimization, ROI, user acquisition, and channel diversification.
category_fits.why_not_fit: The report does not center on media planning, advertising investment, or media effectiveness; marketing is a context for app growth metrics.
evidence_sections: Introduction: Evolution and opportunity in the mobile app industry
rejected_topic_rules: Media and campaign topics appear as routes within a broader app-performance report.
rule_evidence_sections: Introduction: Evolution and opportunity in the mobile app industry
category_fits.remediation_signal: The report does not provide advertising or media strategy as its central guidance.

category_fits.label: Technology & Innovation
category_fits.why_fit: The report references mobile technologies and discusses AI in app marketing workflows.
category_fits.why_not_fit: It benchmarks app installs, engagement, retention, and acquisition rather than examining technology infrastructure, architecture, or technology change as its main lens.
evidence_sections: Introduction: Evolution and opportunity in the mobile app industry
AI transforms from strategic tool to core infrastructure in 2026
rejected_topic_rules: Technology and AI are supporting capabilities within a report focused on app performance.
rule_evidence_sections: Introduction: Evolution and opportunity in the mobile app industry
AI transforms from strategic tool to core infrastructure in 2026
category_fits.remediation_signal: Technology is context and an enabler, rather than the main report subject.
